title: Zelensky critical of U.S.-Russia peace talks, meets with Turkey's Erdogan
description: As officials in Washington, D.C., and Moscow prepare to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is critical of negotiations that exclude his nation.

title: Donald Trump blames Ukraine for starting war with Russia
description: President Trump appeared to blame Ukraine's leaders for the three-year war with Russia, arguing Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky "should have never started it."

title: Heat pump sales in Europe fall 23% to pre-Ukraine war levels
